limitations: Observation snapshots are strictly session-scoped in memory (`deepcopy`) and do not persist across application restarts; persistent storage remains delegated to research projects in the ProjectStore[cite: 13].
Quantitative comparison operations, physical forward-modeling, unit/grid interpolation, and automated scoring remain deferred and strictly blocked at this stage[cite: 13].
summary: Batch 6 introduces an independent observation and molecular reference inspection interface on the Comparisons page without prematurely coupling data into a scoring engine[cite: 13]. The implementation isolates observations by deep-copying imported `SpectrumData` session snapshots, ensuring that subsequent imports or disk alterations do not mutate selected data[cite: 13]. Cached molecular references are revalidated on selection and refreshed safely using exact file path strings in QComboBox[cite: 13]. Cache corruptions or file deletions immediately clear the reference table and reset reference state to prevent stale data display[cite: 13]. The compatibility panel explicitly warns that calculated absorption cross sections cannot be directly compared against observational transit depths without an intermediate physical atmospheric model[cite: 13]. No actionable defects were found.
